content: EFF's 2016 'Large Wordlist' (eff_large_wordlist.txt) has 7776 words (6^5, 5-dice diceware), avg 7.0 chars/word, public-domain, individually addressable by a 5-digit dice-roll key. The eff-diceware-passphrase npm package (last major activity years ago) bundles this list at ~25KB gzipped JSON and does its own CSRNG sampling. Given the project wants hand-rolled crypto.getRandomValues + rejection sampling in TS (CONTEXT.md decision) and to avoid an unmaintained micro-dependency, the recommended approach is to vendor the raw EFF wordlist text as a bundled TS/JSON asset (~7776 lines, one word per line, ~60KB uncompressed / ~25KB gzipped) and write the rejection-sampling selection logic locally rather than depending on any diceware npm package.
